q: When a Gujarat chemical unit sends hazardous waste to a common incinerator, how is that counted?
title: Waste to a common incinerator: scope
short: It is Scope 3, Category 5, waste generated in operations, not your Scope 1. Multiply the tonnes on each manifest by a factor for incinerated waste, ideally from the facility's own fuel and waste records. If none is given, use a stated estimate and mark it as one.
audience: Chemical, dye and pharma units in Ankleshwar, Vapi, Dahej and Nandesari sending waste to common facilities

p: The incinerator is owned and run by someone else. Your Scope 1 covers only fuel and process emissions in equipment you control.

ul: Support fuel used per tonne of waste.
The share of fossil carbon in the waste it receives.
Whether it recovers energy, and how it reports that.

p: Keep the manifests and the facility's invoices by month. They give tonnes, waste category and date, which is what an auditor checks.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, steam, electricity and raw material invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per unit, so a product figure can be traced back to the documents behind it.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
